create_scannet_detection_dataset: create a ScannetDetectionDataset instance for train/val/test split with configurable num_points and augmentation
getitem_scannet_detection_dataset: getitem a sample dict from ScannetDetectionDataset containing point clouds, bounding box labels, and vote labels
len_scannet_detection_dataset: len the ScannetDetectionDataset to get the number of scan names in the selected split
viz_votes: viz_votes visualize point votes and point votes mask labels from a sample dict returned by the dataset
viz_obb: viz_obb visualize oriented bounding box ground truth centroids and boxes from dataset labels
